prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / ads-marketing.
Asset type: a polished raster hero illustration placed to the RIGHT of real Korean headline text on a small-business website builder landing page. Create a NEW image, landscape 4:3 composition, high resolution.
Primary request: show THREE different small-business websites being created together, with INTERIOR DESIGN unmistakably the main business. The image must communicate "I can easily make my business's website" through beautiful real website previews, photography, and restrained visual editing cues.
Composition: three tangible, nearly front-facing white website canvases, subtly overlapping at different heights against a clean PURE WHITE background. The largest, foreground website is an interior design studio and occupies about 60 percent of the visual attention, on center-left. The second, smaller site at upper right is a neighborhood cafe. The third, smaller site at lower right is a florist. Keep all three industries instantly recognizable and all three website page silhouettes legible. Large interior canvas includes a precise header, a big naturally lit warm oak / cream living-room interior photograph, restrained typography, a dark green inquiry button, and a neat row of small project photographs. Cafe page uses a realistic sunlit walnut cafe and espresso/coffee photographs, restrained warm brown typography. Florist page uses realistic fresh flowers, pale peach bouquets, green stems, subtle olive green typography. Each must look like a distinct elegantly designed BUSINESS WEBSITE, with navigation, photography and sections, not just three loose photos.
Creation feeling: show one small photograph tile and two neatly aligned text modules gently coming into place along the lower-left edge of the large interior website. A fine sage-green selection outline around one image, one understated cursor pointer at that outline, and a tiny compact editing strip imply simple website assembly. A single small green check in the main site's top corner implies the finished page is ready. These cues are subtle, believable and subordinate to the website photography. No magic or AI imagery.
Style: premium editorial product visualization, crisp front-facing web layout with only very slight perspective, realistic photographic content, soft short natural shadows for depth, clean generous spacing, warm ivory, oak, white and muted forest-green accents. Sophisticated and human-designed. Avoid glossy 3D plastic, excessive rounded boxes or childish isometric illustration.
Text inside previews only, use these short Korean business names accurately: main "온결인테리어", cafe "모로커피", florist "오후의 꽃". Small readable main button "문의하기". Other body type should be minimal, understated and not visually prominent. Do not add any large headline, caption, slogan, logo or watermark outside the website canvases.
Constraints: white background must reach all four edges, leave comfortable margin around complete canvas silhouettes, no cropping of website outlines, no laptop or phone hardware, no people, no blue/purple gradients, no sparkles, no robots, no arrows, no invented testimonials, no analytics charts. This is conceptual promotional artwork of fictional example websites, not a screenshot of the actual editor.
